upload.title: 회사에서 퇴근, 집으로 출근하는 엄마 | 퇴근 없는 퇴근 #shorts
upload.description:
회사에서 퇴근, 집으로 출근.
두 개의 바위를 굴리는 하루.

카뮈는 말했습니다. 바위를 굴리는 시시포스도 행복하다고 상상해야 한다고.
그런데 오늘, 현관문을 열었더니…

🎵 퇴근 없는 퇴근 - MIDLIFE COMMUTER
💬 오늘 당신의 '진짜 퇴근'은 언제였나요? 댓글로 들려주세요.

가사는 사람이 쓰고, 음악(ACE-Step)과 그림은 AI와 함께 만들었습니다.

#워킹맘 #직장맘 #퇴근 #엄마 #육아 #시시포스 #위로 #직장인공감 #MIDLIFECOMMUTER #shorts

shots.plate: close view inside a Korean city bus at night, one large bus window fills the background, outside it the blurred night city lights and street lamps, a yellow grab pole beside the window, no seats, no signs with letters
shots.motion: the tired woman stands still in the night bus, sighs, her head slowly tilts and droops to one side, eyes closed, her hands stay down, the bus sways gently, the night city lights outside the window behind her drift past
avoid: Does the picture suddenly change into a different scene or camera angle?
Is it daytime outside the windows?
Is the woman touching her nose or covering her face with her hand?
Are there more than 1 people (one woman)?

shots.plate: inside a Korean city bus at night, close view by the window, a hand strap, warm interior light, blurred city lights outside
shots.motion: the woman looks down at her phone and taps the screen, the city lights drift past behind her
avoid: Are there more than 1 people (one woman)?
Does the picture suddenly change into a different scene or camera angle?

shots.plate: a simple Korean neighborhood supermarket aisle at night seen at eye level, open wooden shelves with vegetables, fruit, ramen packets and boxes on both sides, flat floor, bright ceiling lights, no glass, no refrigerators, no display cases, no glass doors
shots.motion: the woman walks quickly along the supermarket aisle, the shelves pass by, the lights glow
avoid: Are there more than 1 people (one woman)?
Does the picture suddenly change into a different scene or camera angle?
Is any object floating in the air?
Does any glass, shelf or product bulge, melt, bend or warp?
avoid_key: Is there a glass refrigerator or glass display case in the picture?

shots.plate: a bright Korean office in the daytime seen at eye level, desks with monitors, a glass meeting room behind, a big window with soft daylight
shots.motion: the boss talks and points at a document, the woman nods with a forced polite smile, the monitors glow
avoid: Are there more than 2 people (one woman and one man)?
Does the picture suddenly change into a different scene or camera angle?

shots.plate: the front entrance hallway (hyeongwan) inside a Korean apartment at night seen at eye level, a shoe cabinet, family shoes on the floor, warm light from the living room
shots.motion: the woman stands at the entrance and her tired face slowly softens into a small smile, warm light glows from inside
avoid: Are there more than 1 people (one woman)?
Does the picture suddenly change into a different scene or camera angle?

shots.plate: a dark Korean office at night seen at eye level, rows of empty desks, most lights off, one desk lamp on, a wall clock showing past nine
shots.motion: the woman stands at her desk and looks down at her phone with a tired face, the desk lamp glows, the dark office stays still
avoid: Are there more than 1 people (one woman)?
Does the picture suddenly change into a different scene or camera angle?

shots.plate: the closed front door of a Korean apartment at night seen from the hallway at eye level, a door number plate, a digital door lock, a dim hallway light
shots.motion: the woman stands still in front of the closed door and takes a deep breath, the hallway light flickers softly
avoid: Are there more than 1 people (one woman)?
Does the door open?
Does the picture suddenly change into a different scene or camera angle?

shots.plate: a long steep stone stairway street in an old Seoul hillside neighborhood at night seen at eye level, small houses with warm windows on both sides, old street lamps, a big full moon above, the stairs are empty, no vehicles, nobody else
shots.motion: the woman climbs the steep stairs step by step with tired but steady steps, her hair and bag sway with each step, the camera slowly follows her up the stairs, the street lamps glow, the moon shines, the stairs stay empty around her
avoid: Is there a car, bicycle, scooter or motorbike anywhere in the picture?
Are there more than 1 people (one woman)?
Does the picture suddenly change into a different scene or camera angle?
Is the woman standing still without moving her legs?

shots.plate: the top of a hillside stairway in Seoul at night, a low wall, the city lights spread far below, a big full moon
shots.motion: the woman looks up at the full moon and a small smile spreads on her face, the city lights twinkle far below
avoid: Is there a car, bicycle or motorbike anywhere in the picture?
Are there more than 1 people (one woman)?
Does the picture suddenly change into a different scene or camera angle?

shots.plate: a warm Korean apartment dining room at night seen at eye level, a dining table already set with dinner, rice bowls and a stew pot, warm pendant light, no windows
shots.motion: the father and the son smile and wave at the camera from the dinner table they prepared, steam rises from the stew pot, the pendant light glows
avoid: Are there more than 2 people (one man and one boy)?
Does the picture suddenly change into a different scene or camera angle?
Is any object floating in the air?
Is steam coming from somewhere other than the pot?

shots.plate: the front entrance hallway (hyeongwan) inside a Korean apartment at night seen at eye level, warm golden light pouring from the living room, a wooden shoe cabinet, plain walls, no windows, no glass doors
shots.motion: the woman stands still at the entrance, her eyes widen with surprise and then she smiles warmly, the camera does not move closer, the warm light stays the same
avoid: Are there more than 1 people (one woman)?
Does the picture suddenly change into a different scene or camera angle?

shots.plate: close view of one plain lavender wall corner at night seen at eye level, a big glowing star-shaped lamp on the wall, small star stickers, a small white dresser with a teddy bear, a round fluffy rug on the empty wooden floor, nothing else in the room, no bed, no bunk bed, no loft bed, no mattress, no sofa, no windows, in present-day South Korea
shots.motion: the mother stays standing in the same spot right beside the head of the bed, her feet do not move, she only bends gently at the waist toward the sleeping girl and kisses her forehead with a loving smile, the girl sleeps peacefully under the blanket, the night lamp glows
avoid: Are there two beds in the picture?
Are there more than 2 people (one woman and one sleeping girl)?
Does the picture suddenly change into a different scene or camera angle?
Is the woman standing inside the bed, on top of the bed, or walking through the bed?
avoid_key: Are there two beds in the picture?
Is there a bunk bed or loft bed in the picture?
Is there a bed or a sofa in the background behind the people?

shots.plate: a cozy Korean apartment living room at night seen at eye level, a sofa, a warm floor lamp, a family photo on the wall, no windows
shots.motion: the wife and husband smile at each other warmly, she lets out a long relieved breath, the floor lamp glows
avoid: Are there more than 2 people (one woman and one man)?
Does the picture suddenly change into a different scene or camera angle?

shots.plate: the front entrance (hyeongwan) of a Korean apartment at night, four pairs of shoes lined up neatly including a pair of women's black heels, warm dim light
shots.motion: the woman stands still looking toward the warm living room, the light glows softly, the shoes stay still
must: shoes lined up on the floor
avoid: Are there more than 1 people (one woman)?
Does the picture suddenly change into a different scene or camera angle?
Are any shoes moving?
